title: Filtering the products table by numbers · part 4

steps.title: Keep id >= 11
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where id is at least 11.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE id >= 11;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is id >= 11.
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE id >= 11;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE id >= 11;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows id >= 11
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE id >= 11;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM products.
Add WHERE id >= 11.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE id >= 11;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE id >= 11;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'
